description: Curated starter prerequisite graph for CareerFit growth simulations.
methodology: Edges point from prerequisite to learnable target. Structure, taxonomy membership, positive hour estimates, and acyclicity are validated automatically. Domain relationships are starter heuristics and should be reviewed by subject-matter experts before high-stakes use.

python.rationale: General programming foundation for the Python data and web ecosystem.

java.rationale: Programming foundation for JVM and Spring applications.

cpp.rationale: Adds object-oriented and standard-library concepts to a C foundation.

javascript.rationale: Core programming language for interactive web development.

typescript.rationale: Adds static typing and tooling to JavaScript.

html.rationale: Structure and semantics for web pages.

css.rationale: Presentation and responsive layout for HTML documents.

statistics.rationale: Foundation for reliable analysis and model evaluation.

linux.rationale: Command-line and operating-system foundation for development and deployment.

numpy.rationale: Numerical arrays and vectorised computing in Python.

pandas.rationale: Tabular data manipulation using Python and NumPy concepts.

data_analysis.rationale: Combines statistical reasoning, querying, and tabular transformation.

data_science.rationale: Integrates analysis, modelling, and data querying.

pygame.rationale: Interactive graphics and event loops in Python.
